room_rent.display: No cap (base); 1% of SI/day up to ₹5,000 optional
room_rent.note: Base policy has no room rent sub-limit mentioned. Room Rent Modification Option (optional add-on) caps at 1% of Basic SI per day up to ₹5,000/day with proportionate deduction.

icu.display: No cap (base); 2% of SI/day up to ₹10,000 optional
icu.note: Base policy has no ICU cap. Room Rent Modification Option (optional) caps ICU at 2% of Basic SI per day up to ₹10,000/day.

copayment.display: None (base); 20% if Tier-2 insured treats in Tier-1 city
copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay on base plan. Tier-2 premium payers face 20% co-pay for treatment in Tier-1 cities. Optional Co-Payment add-on also available.

sub_limits.note: Base inpatient cover has no disease-wise sub-limits. Optional Room Rent Modification introduces room/ICU caps. Organ donor excludes pre/post-hosp expenses.

deductible.note: No base deductible. Global Health Cover optional add-on has USD 100 deductible per claim.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; waived for accidents. Not applicable if continuously covered for 12+ months.

ped_waiting.note: Standard PED waiting period is 48 months. Waiting Period Modification Option (optional add-on) may reduce this as per Schedule of Coverage.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions (cataract, hernia, joint replacement, etc.) have 24-month waiting period. Waiting Period Modification Option can reduce this.

maternity.note: Maternity not covered in base plan. Available via Parent and Child Care Cover – Basic or Booster optional add-on with 48-month waiting period. Covers delivery, C-section, termination, pre/post-natal OPD. Booster also covers infertility treatment up to 50% of normal delivery SI.

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% of Basic SI added per claim-free year, up to 50% max. Reduced at same rate on claim. Extended Cumulative Bonus optional add-on can increase the rate/cap as per Schedule.

restoration.display: Once/yr up to Basic SI (Sum Insured Rebound)
restoration.note: Optional Sum Insured Rebound add-on restores an amount equal to the claim paid (up to Basic SI) on subsequent hospitalisation in same year. Not unlimited; chemo/dialysis limited to once in policy lifetime. Not inbuilt.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days before admission, provided inpatient claim is admissible.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 180 days after discharge, provided inpatient claim is admissible.

day_care.note: Day Care Treatment covered in Hospital or Day Care Centre under general inpatient cover terms.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary Hospitalisation covered when patient cannot be moved to hospital or no room available, as prescribed by treating doctor.

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient treatment covered in AYUSH Hospital for Ayurveda, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy, Yoga & Naturopathy. Procedure must not be doable on outpatient basis.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor hospitalisation expenses for harvesting covered when insured is recipient. Pre/post-hosp expenses of donor excluded.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered for emergency transfer, hospital-to-hospital, and hospital-to-home (same city). No explicit rupee cap stated in wording.

modern_treatments.note: Policy wording does not explicitly mention modern/robotic treatments as a named benefit or exclusion. Covered implicitly under general medical expenses if medically necessary.

consumables.note: Non-Medical Expenses cover is an optional add-on (Section B-III-10) that covers consumables/non-medical items up to limit in Schedule. Base plan excludes non-medical expenses.

global_cover.note: Global Health Cover (Section B-III-18) is an optional add-on covering treatment outside India for listed sections. USD 100 deductible per claim applies. Reimbursement in INR only.

moratorium.note: After 8 continuous years, no claim can be contested except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions. Sub-limits, co-pays and deductibles still apply.

grace_period.note: 30-day grace period for annual/half-yearly/quarterly renewals; 15 days for monthly instalments. No coverage during grace period.

free_look.note: 15-day free-look period on new policies only; not applicable on renewals or portability.

portability.note: Portability to other insurers allowed as per IRDAI guidelines. Apply at least 45 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: OPD treatment, stem cell harvesting, congenital external anomalies, sleep apnoea investigation, spinal manipulation, alopecia/baldness treatment, external prosthetics/aids

optional_riders.display: Sum Insured Rebound, Global Health Cover, Maternity (Basic/Booster), Air Ambulance, Non-Medical Expenses, Major Illness Benefit, Extended Cumulative Bonus, Room Rent Modification, Co-Payment, Hospital Cash, E-Opinion
